title: Zero Trust Browser Licensing and Fair Use

blocks.text: Zero Trust Browser (including Zero Trust Cloud Browser, Zero Trust Browser Extension, and Zero Trust Enterprise Browser) is a Software as a Service (SaaS) product that is licensed according to the number of seats purchased for the subscription term in an order.

A seat is a subscription license for the Zero Trust Browser service for an individual authorized user. The number of seats required is determined by calculating the total number of unique individual users of the Zero Trust Browser service over a rolling 90-day period.

Your usage of the Zero Trust Cloud Browser service is also subject to the data consumption limits stated in your Zero Trust Browser SKU. If your purchased SKU does not state a specific data limit, your usage is subject to the parameters of the Fair Use Policy below.

Ensure that you order the correct number of seats. If you require additional seats during a subscription term, contact Zscaler Sales or your Channel Partner. Zscaler periodically reviews the number of seats to ensure license compliance.

The usage of Zero Trust Browser is expected to be in accordance with the Acceptable Use Policy. To maintain optimal performance and stability across the Zscaler multi-tenant cloud, data consumption is limited to the stated data limits in the purchased SKU. If no data limits are explicitly mentioned, then the allowable average monthly traffic across all purchased seats must be less than two times (2x) the current cloud-wide average (currently 8 GB per seat per month), plus any additional bandwidth entitlements explicitly stated in your contract. This Fair Use Policy encompasses all data uploaded and downloaded via the Zero Trust Cloud Browser.
